_comment: Things about this system that are true whether or not anyone remembers them. Every entry below was learned by shipping the mistake. Read by `blastradius --brief` before a change.

constraints.rule: The WhatsApp webhook must send its HTTP response in well under 15 seconds
constraints.because: Twilio abandons the request at ~15s (error 11200) and the customer receives no reply at all — the agent looks broken to them while the logs look fine to you
constraints.learned: Raising maxOutputTokens to 2048 took one turn to 25s. The customer's 'yes confirm' got no answer, and they messaged again asking where the payment link was.

constraints.rule: gemini-flash-latest is a thinking model and its reasoning is billed against maxOutputTokens
constraints.because: A budget sized for the visible reply gets consumed by reasoning, and the message is truncated mid-word on its way to a customer
constraints.learned: At 700 tokens replies ended '...delivery to Kum'. This endpoint also rejects thinkingConfig with 400, so thinking cannot simply be turned off.

constraints.rule: Anything sent over the Twilio REST API needs TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID and TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN; a TwiML reply needs neither
constraints.because: Twilio delivers a TwiML reply itself. Moving a reply to the REST API adds an authentication requirement that the old path never had, and a 401 is invisible to the customer and to the panel
constraints.learned: Replies were moved out of band while production had no Twilio credentials. Every reply 401'd for hours: the agent generated and stored answers the customer never received.

constraints.rule: A tapped WhatsApp list row arrives as its row id; a tapped quick-reply arrives as its label
constraints.because: Treating a row id as the answer picks whatever happens to be first, which prices the order wrongly and silently
constraints.learned: Tapping a delivery zone sent 'row_1'. It answered correctly only because the cheapest zone sorts first; the third zone would have been billed at the first zone's fee.

constraints.rule: A Twilio trial account sends at most 50 messages per rolling 24 hours
constraints.because: Past the cap every send is refused with error 63038, which looks exactly like a broken agent from the outside
constraints.learned: A day of testing spent the cap. Diagnosing it took an hour because a refused send left no trace in the app at all.

invariants.rule: Revenue is orders where status = 'paid'. Payment status belongs to the Paystack webhook
invariants.because: Several queries across the panel and the daily report define revenue this way, and it is the number the business is judged on
invariants.never: Add a value to orders.status without checking every query that filters it. Fulfilment and other axes get their own column — delivered_at exists for exactly this reason.
invariants.learned: A 'delivered' status was one commit from shipping. It would have removed paid orders from every revenue total, quietly.

invariants.rule: Every router mounted under /admin applies requireAuth itself
invariants.because: Express middleware is per-router, so a new router under a guarded prefix inherits nothing
invariants.never: Mount a router at /admin and assume the admin router's guard covers it
invariants.learned: The setup wizard was mounted unguarded. Vendor creation was reachable with no session until it was caught before deploy.

invariants.rule: The agent sells only what is in that vendor's catalog and quotes only that vendor's delivery zones
invariants.because: An invented product or price is a promise the shop has to honour or break, and it destroys the trust the whole product runs on
invariants.never: Put a concrete product, price or place in the prompt as an example — it primes the model to offer it to a vendor who does not stock it
invariants.learned: Examples used one shop's real products. A test food vendor was at risk of being offered clothing.

invariants.rule: The agent matches the customer's language and register; it never opens in pidgin
invariants.because: A tone note permitting pidgin is permission to match it, not to choose it — the customer may not speak it
invariants.learned: A customer writing plain English was answered in pidgin because the shop's tone note allowed it.

invariants.rule: A send that does not reach the customer is recorded and surfaced in the panel
invariants.because: A silent failure is indistinguishable from a broken agent, and costs hours to diagnose from the outside
invariants.learned: A spent message quota looked identical to a broken agent: the panel showed a reply, the phone showed nothing, and the only evidence was in the Twilio console.
